_meta.method: Web research across the official directories of Comunidad Buddhista Soto Zen (sotozen.es), Sotoshu Europe (sotozen.com), Asociación Zen Internacional / Kosen Sangha (zen-deshimaru.com, zenkan.com), Templo Seikyuji affiliates, Camino Medio (caminomedio.org), Instituto Internacional Zen de España (Lam Te / Rinzai), Kwan Um Europe (kwanumeurope.org, boricentro.kwanumzen.es), Comunidad Budista del Interser (tnhspain.com), Buddhistdoor en Español Catalonia/Balearic directory, and the IRIZ Hanazono University zen centers list. Each entry was cross-verified against at least one institutional/network directory. Batch23: checked Seikyuji-affiliated local dojos against the current Seikyuji dojos directory on 2026-10-08; the directory is the item-level source for affiliation and addresses. Batch25 (2026-10-08): item-level verification of selected high-priority Spain/UK records against AZI, Camino Medio, Nalanda, OBC, Cambridge/Lancaster group pages, and London Fo Guang Shan; see scripts/data/raw/spain-uk-batch25-2026-10-08.md.
_meta.coverageEstimate: Strong coverage of the four main networks (Sōtō CBSZ, AZI/Kosen-Deshimaru, Seikyuji/Camino Medio, Kwan Um) and the Plum Village lay sangha network. Sanbō Zen presence in Spain is a single hub (Zendo Betania + offshoots). Rinzai presence is limited (Vietnamese Lam Te lineage via IIZE). No active Ōbaku presence located. Plum Village lay sanghas are listed selectively (representative subset of ~50 groups; many are home-based without a fixed dojo).
knownGaps: Some Plum Village 'sanghas' meet in private homes without a fixed practice place — not all are listed
Ōbaku-shū has no documented active presence in Spain
White Plum Asanga has no resident Spanish teacher / fixed center
A few small Soto groups (e.g. Mokusan Dojo Madrid sub-groups) may overlap with parent dojos
Phone-only / email-only contacts dropped where no institutional URL was confirmed
Address not always public (privacy of host venues); kept null where unknown but URL+source confirmed
